answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 2509 Country: Pakistan Title: Is killing of ants( makoray and chunty) haram, makruh, mubah, please clarify? Question: as-salaam u alaikum Is killing of ants( makoray and chunty) haram, makruh, mubah, please clarify? Answer ID: 2509 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 700/685=L) According to Hadith it is allowed to kill harmful animal before it gives you harm. Therefore, harmful ants or insects can be killed, but the animals and insects which do not give any harm they should not be killed unnecessarily. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
